topic: Sources and Uses of Sound Energy
key_concepts: Sound energy is produced when objects vibrate.
Sound can travel through solids such as a table.
Sound can travel through different states of matter.
A knock can sound different when heard through a solid than through air.
Harder knocks use more force and can change the sound heard.
Musical instruments are sources of sound energy.
Sound energy can convey information through communication.
People, animals, nature, household objects, and electronics can be sources of sound energy
Some sounds can be harmful to ears.
